# Unstable Innovation

> A book about innovation, entrepreneurship, and philosophy by Salvadoran entrepreneur **Nelson Inno**, founder and CEO of WeSpark. Published January 2025. The book explores how embracing chaos, uncertainty, acceleration, and the fragile moments of breakthrough is the path to true innovation. It draws on Stoicism, game theory, megatrends, and the author's career across aviation, finance, education, and Bitcoin.

Author: Nelson Inno (Salvadoran, b. 1991) — founder & CEO of [WeSpark](https://wespark.io), TEDx speaker, co-designer of Bitcoin Diploma 2.0 with El Salvador's National Bitcoin Office. Also author of *Thinking in Images* (forthcoming 2026) and *Diplomado en Bitcoin* (2026). Personal site: [nelsoninno.com](https://nelsoninno.com).

Mantra: *Be the ordinary, build the extraordinary.*

Operating principles: (1) Add value to others. (2) Focus on what truly matters. (3) Never forget your roots.

Book is available as: Paperback (Amazon, 12 storefronts), Kindle eBook (Amazon, 13 storefronts), and free PDF + EPUB + AZW3 directly from this site. Also translated to Spanish as *Innovación Inestable* (translation funded by the Gloria Kriete Foundation). 5.0 / 5.0 stars across 11 verified Amazon and Goodreads reviews.
